title: Quarterly kickoff initiative map and fallthrough strategy for hosted models
creator: Priya Patel
description: Run a focused quarterly kickoff to produce an initiative map for the Hosted API model catalog that explicitly contains primary lanes and fallthrough (contingency) strategies. The deliverable will be a prioritized initiative map, a decision matrix for model rotations and canaries, and a failover playbook describing acceptable substitutes and rollback thresholds. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Design, and SRE input, creates decision artifacts for the exec sync, and seeds the cycle backlog with measurable milestones.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative map with prioritized lanes (Tier A/B/C) reviewed and approved by PM + Eng by 2025-01-29
Canary & fallback decision matrix published with concrete substitute model pairs and latency/cost thresholds
Playbook doc with runbook steps for fallback, including monitoring triggers (error rate, latency, cost spike) and rollback criteria
Stakeholder sign-offs from Growth, Platform, and SRE captured in doc and meeting notes
At least three candidate experiments (A/B or canary) added to the cycle backlog with owners and estimates
milestones: 2025-01-15: Cross-functional kickoff workshop (90m) — align scope and constraints
2025-01-22: First draft initiative map and dependency heatmap
2025-01-29: Review session with Eng leads and Design; lock Tier assignments
2025-02-05: Finalize canary/fallback decision matrix and publish playbook
2025-02-12: Backlog seeding: create execution tickets and assign owners
2025-03-21: Pre-exec review and readiness check before quarter demo
stakeholders: Maya Singh (Design) — UX for rollout dashboard
Jonas Becker (Growth) — canary population and metrics
risks: Unclear substitution matrix: some model pairs produce divergent quality for certain prompts
Capacity constraints in Dedicated pools could invalidate fallback choices
Insufficient monitoring coverage for semantic-quality regressions
metrics: Number of initiative lanes with assigned owners (target: 6+)
Time-to-rollback in simulated canary tests (target < 5m to switch route)
Projected token cost delta for fallback scenarios (must be < 25% over baseline)
Percentage of canary experiments with defined success criteria (target 100%)
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Alignment & mapping — produce initiative map and decision matrix
Phase 1: Pilot canaries for two Tier A endpoints with SLO guardrails
Phase 2: Expand fallthrough coverage to Tier B and automate routing policies
Phase 3: Post-rollout review and retro; fold learnings into Optimize recommendations
